user.title: Choose your Quran lamp
user.description: Select a nearby lamp or enter its Bluetooth address manually.

no_lamps.title: No Quran lamps found
no_lamps.description: Power on the lamp, keep it near the Bluetooth adapter, and close the Koran Prayer app. Then try again.

no_new_lamps.title: No new Quran lamps found
no_new_lamps.description: The lamps found are already configured. Power on the lamp you want to add and select Look again.

confirm.title: Connect to the Quran lamp
confirm.description: Home Assistant will check the lamp at {address}. Keep the lamp powered and close the Koran Prayer app before connecting.

manual.title: Add a Quran lamp by address
manual.description: Enter the lamp’s Bluetooth MAC address. Keep the lamp powered and close the Koran Prayer app before connecting.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check that the lamp is powered, within Bluetooth range, and disconnected from the Koran Prayer app, then try again.
error.unsupported_model: The device at this address did not identify itself as a supported SQ953 lamp.

abort.already_configured: This Quran lamp is already configured.
abort.unsupported_model: The connected lamp does not identify itself as SQ953.

init.title: Prayer time synchronization
init.description: Select the prayer sensors you want to sync. Leave a field blank to keep the time currently stored on the lamp. Use the Built-in azan switch on the device page to enable or mute the five prayer alarms.
